image_description: A full-body shot of a De Brazza's monkey (a type of guenon) standing upright on its hind legs in a grassy area with purple flowers. The monkey has distinctive facial markings including an orange crescent on the forehead, a white beard/ruff, and dark fur on the back with a white belly. It is looking towards the left. The background consists of green foliage and bluebells.
